lines.en: A run of clicks as my legs tap the ground.
I walk along the wall; it saves effort.
The lich is ahead; I follow.
The ground is too bright; I keep to shadow.
Every leg finds a steady hold.
My claw marks crowd the frost.
I crawl over stone as if over bone.
Do not count my legs; you will lose track.
I walk sideways and still outpace you.
In the dark I move faster.
One whistle from the lich and I arrive.
I have smelled this road many times.
My mandibles grind with a click.
I hang from the ceiling, looking down.
With no command, I wait.
My limbs twitch on their own.
The shell is hollow; there is no blood.
I am counting the cracks in the wall.
The lich has not spoken yet.
My feet tap the ground like a beat.
This stone is just cool enough.
The smell of the living has not come yet.
Many eyes, all on you.
You are taller than the last prey.
A tilt of my head; I am measuring you.
Can you run? Run for me.
Hold still; let me see you clearly.
The thing in your hand rattles.
The lich said to watch you first.

lines.zh: 你的影子，落到我脚边了。
lines.en: Your shadow has reached my feet.
I look at you the way I look at a meal.
Many eyes, and they watch for a long time.
The shell cracked; I can still crawl.
One leg broke; others remain.
I do not bleed; I only shed flakes.
It hurts, so I crawl faster.
My mandibles are intact; that is enough.
Hit my shell and your hand will hurt.
That blow left my legs numb.
Do not step on me; I will flip over.
The shell regrows, just slowly.
I withdraw into the crack and come out again.
Food? The lich gives only orders.
Leave the meat; I do not eat it warm.
I would rather bite something that moves.
That smell makes my mandibles itch.
Luring me with meat will not work.
I am hungry, but only for the living.
Bones suit my appetite better than bread.
Put it away. Do not wave it.
The lich does not let me feed at will.
Food rots; commands do not.
You stepped on one of my legs.
My mandibles are by your feet. Careful.
Bump me; this shell is hard.
Do not kick my plating.
I crawled right past you.
Your boot is in my way.
Touch me and you will smell of grave soil.
One step back; I am passing.
Many legs; one knock does not hurt.
Move; the lich is calling me.
We are not born; we are made.
No eggs, and no young.
The lich's summoning is faster than laying eggs.
We jointed things do not pair up.
My kind crawl up from grave soil.
Mating? That is the living's business.

lines.zh: 壳里没有能传下去的东西。
lines.en: There is nothing in this shell to pass on.
Want more scuttlers? Ask the lich.
I know commands, not partners.

lines.zh: 这一身壳，到死都是孤的。
lines.en: This shell stays alone until it breaks.
The shard glints; I drag it back to the nest.
I pinch it with my mandibles; easier.
Gold coins grit my teeth. No.
The lich will like this.

lines.zh: 捡东西这种事，我用螯齿。
lines.en: For picking things up, I use my mandibles.
Dropped is dropped; do not push it at me.
This shard belongs to the Dread Lair.
I drag it along, a little slower.
Something shiny; I will hide it first.
You want to pick it up? Ask my teeth first.
One click, and you are my mark.
The lich pointed at you; you are the one.
Every leg coils, ready to spring.
You stepped into my shadow.
My mandibles open. Do you hear it?
It is alive and moving; chase it.
Do not run; running makes you smell better.
The order came down; bad luck for you.
Dropping from above is easiest.
You give off heat; easy to find.
I move first; the lich comes after.
This wall is my hunting ground.
You have reached the corner. How convenient.
I will pass above you.

lines.zh: 尸巫的骨指一动，我就知道了。
lines.en: The lich's bone finger twitches, and I know.
I hug the ground, following your feet.

lines.zh: 你转向哪边，我跟到哪边。
lines.en: Whichever way you turn, I follow.
The clicking is getting closer.
Do not look up; I am on the beam.
Your shadow is within my bite.
Stop, and I pounce.

lines.zh: 霜地上，你的脚印很清楚。
lines.en: Your prints stand out clearly on the frost.
I have circled around ahead of you.
Through the cracks I travel faster than you.
Do you hear the jointed legs?
Keep running and your legs give out first.
The lich's skull is hunting you too.
I tally each step you take.
The circle is closing.

lines.zh: 我把腿收起来，准备弹出去。
lines.en: I gather my legs to spring.

lines.zh: 你听着声音找不对方向，对吧。
lines.en: You hear me but cannot find the direction, right?
The frost steadies my climbing, no slipping.

lines.zh: 我躲在柱子背面，等你踏进来。
lines.en: I hide behind the pillar, waiting for your step.
My mandibles close and catch hold.
This bite lands on bone.
My legs pin you. Stop struggling.
My teeth are harder than a blade.
One pinch and your armor dents.
You guard high; I bite low.
Biting from behind takes least effort.
The mandibles snap shut with a crisp sound.

lines.zh: 武器是多余的，螯齿够用。
lines.en: Weapons are surplus; my mandibles suffice.
This strike is what the lich wanted.
You have fallen down. Perfect timing.
My shell slams in and you give ground.
Do not block with your hand; it will not hold.
Once my jaws shut, they do not open.

lines.zh: 我一扑，前肢锁住你的肩。
lines.en: I pounce and my forelimbs lock onto your shoulder.

lines.zh: 螯齿刺进甲缝，拔不出来。
lines.en: My chelicerae pierce the gap in your armour and stay.
I squeeze out of the wall crack.
The soil loosened; I climb up.
The lich raised a hand and I arrived.
Grave soil still clings to my shell.
This place has room for my legs.
The dark stirs first, then me.
I heard someone come in.
The clicking starts underground.
My nest is right below here.
The corners of the Dread Lair are mine.
No light; good for the work.
Legs first, shell after.
Who loosened the soil?
I am here; do not step on my legs.
Fire scorches my shell; the smell is foul.
I hit the ground with my legs tangled.
Water fills my shell and I sink fast.
The blast took some legs; I still crawl.
An arrow is lodged in my plating.

lines.zh: 法术打进壳缝，麻了一下。
lines.en: A spell slipped into a seam and numbed me.
I do not eat, and I do not starve.
Lightning runs down my legs and lights the shell.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有墙，我抓不住。
lines.en: No walls in the void; I cannot grip.
